result.topic_en: Notes on the damped vibrating string (with an elastic after-effect/memory integral term) and on describing small deformations of a medium via principal dilatations, linear coordinate transformations and the elastic forces that tend to restore a body's shape.

methods.what: d'Alembert general solution of the wave equation for a vibrating wire
Wave equation rewritten as time integral (hereditary form)
Generalized equation with a memory kernel equal to 1 for a sufficient time, decaying to zero (elastic after-effect)
Simultaneous diagonalization of the deformed metric: orthogonal linear forms ds_i and principal stretches G_i
